newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA FIRMLY ON TOP OF THE WORLD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA FIRMLY ON TOP OF THE WORLD.

text.p: Australia strengthened their position on top of the cricketing world after beating South Africa in the second test in Port Elizabeth on Monday to take a 2-0 winning lead in the three-match series.
They are now four points clear of India and South Africa at the head of the Wisden world championship, and only an improbable set of results could lead to them being overhauled at any time this year.
The championship, devised by Wisden Cricketers' Almanack, is unofficial, but South Africa intend to propose at the International Cricket Council (ICC) meeting in June that it be adopted officially.

Rankings are based on the most recent meetings, both home and away, between each pair of teams, with two points for winning each series or one-off test and one for drawing. The difference between the number played and points decides placings.
